Paths are relative to `https://api.notion.com`; **Admin paths include `/admin`**. Public API and Admin API versions are separate: the latest documented versions are **`2026-03-11`** and **`2026-06-01`**, respectively. [Public version changes](https://developers.notion.com/reference/changes-by-version), [Admin versioning](https://developers.notion.com/reference/admin/versioning).

**Cursor pagination — public API**

For these endpoints, pass the returned `next_cursor` as `start_cursor`: in query parameters for GET requests, and the JSON body for POST requests. Check each endpoint’s `page_size` limits. [Pagination conventions](https://developers.notion.com/reference/intro#pagination).

Two distinctions matter: [Append block children](https://developers.notion.com/reference/patch-block-children) returns a list-shaped response but accepts no pagination cursor; use Retrieve block children to read children in pages. [Query meeting notes](https://developers.notion.com/reference/query-meeting-notes) explicitly **does not support cursor pagination**, despite returning `has_more`.

**Deprecated endpoints and database parameters**

The `2025-09-03` migration splits database containers from data sources. Some paths remain valid with new semantics; the deprecated item is their older combined database/schema behavior.

| Endpoint or parameter | Method | Old path | Changed in | Replacement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [List databases](https://developers.notion.com/reference/get-databases) | GET | `/v1/databases` | **`2022-02-22` removal** | `POST /v1/search`; on current versions, use the `data_source` object filter for data sources |
| [Create a database — legacy](https://developers.notion.com/reference/create-a-database) | POST | `/v1/databases` | `2025-09-03` | Current `POST /v1/databases` for the container and initial data source; `POST /v1/data_sources` to add a data source |
| [Retrieve a database — legacy](https://developers.notion.com/reference/retrieve-a-database) | GET | `/v1/databases/{database_id}` | `2025-09-03` | Same path for container metadata; `GET /v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}` for schema |
| [Update a database — legacy](https://developers.notion.com/reference/update-a-database) | PATCH | `/v1/databases/{database_id}` | `2025-09-03` | Same path for container attributes; `PATCH /v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}` for schema/data-source attributes |
| [Query a database](https://developers.notion.com/reference/post-database-query) | POST | `/v1/databases/{database_id}/query` | `2025-09-03` | `POST /v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}/query` |
| [Database query `filter`](https://developers.notion.com/reference/post-database-query-filter) | POST | `/v1/databases/{database_id}/query` | `2025-09-03` | `filter` on Query a data source |
| [Database query `sorts`](https://developers.notion.com/reference/post-database-query-sort) | POST | `/v1/databases/{database_id}/query` | `2025-09-03` | `sorts` on Query a data source |
| [Database schema `properties`](https://developers.notion.com/reference/update-property-schema-object) | PATCH | `/v1/databases/{database_id}` | `2025-09-03` | `properties` on `PATCH /v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}` |

**Documentation inconsistency:** List databases currently carries a `2025-09-03` deprecation banner, but its body restricts availability to `2021-08-16` and earlier. The historical changelog explicitly places removal in **`2022-02-22`**. [Historical changelog](https://developers.notion.com/guides/resources/historical-changelog).

The database migration also changes page parents from `database_id` to `data_source_id` when creating database rows, relation schema targets to `data_source_id`, and Search’s database filter/result concept to `data_source`. Use the new IDs when migrating. [2025-09-03 upgrade guide](https://developers.notion.com/guides/get-started/upgrade-guide-2025-09-03).
